decisions.statement: A row has the standing category by its title where a page names that category.
A row has the standing category by its slug where no page names that category.
A transaction resolving other than exactly one line is refused.
A neighbourhood is read from the database over twice the rule's window.
The in-memory slice takes the same span as that database read.
A rule with no counterpart clause reads no neighbourhood at all.
A missing field reads as empty rather than as absent.
Every row has the same shape.

definition: our copy of Monarch read as the rows a rule is weighed against
